description: This file defines a grain interface and implementation for subscribing to streams, along with a serializable class representing a full stream identity, used within Orleans stream-based messaging.

classes.name: ISubscribeGrain
classes.description: Interface defining a grain that can verify subscription management availability

classes.name: SubscribeGrain
classes.description: Implementation of ISubscribeGrain that interacts with Orleans stream providers

classes.name: FullStreamIdentity
classes.description: Serializable class representing a detailed stream identity including provider name, guid, and namespace

methods.name: CanGetSubscriptionManager
methods.description: Checks if the specified stream provider has a subscription manager available
